pathAssistantSteps.info: Minor application cancelled by the guardian.
Minor passport delivered to the guardian. Terminal state.
Dispatch to the guardian's address on record. Received By must name an adult.
Verify birth certificate, both parents' passports/ID, and the Guardian Consent declaration. Do not proceed without both-parent consent.
Minor draft (under 18). Applied For Minor must be checked and Guardian Name captured. Validity is 5 years, 36-page booklet only.
Grant only with Guardian Consent recorded as true and both parents' details on file.
Fee received. Proceed to document verification.
Minor fee (5-year, 36-page) applies. Guardian normally pays.
Minors are No PV where at least one parent holds a valid passport. Refer to police only if that condition fails.
Rejected - most commonly missing or disputed parental consent.
Submitted for a minor. Annexure D consent signed by BOTH parents is mandatory; Annexure C only where one parent is unavailable.
